Bayes gives a GIG posterior proportional to a^(-1/2) exp(-ra-y²/(4Da)). Evaluating its half-integer Bessel moments gives P1=z+1, P2=z²+3z+3 and P3=z³+6z²+15z+15. Total conditional expectation and variance yield the exact formulas on all real y including y=0 by continuity. value.rationale: The height-resolved transport and dispersion in a reset-sheared Brownian tracer are directly observable and not specified by published spatial averages. The exact nonlinear conditional mean grows as y|y| even though applied shear velocity is linear in y, while the conditional horizontal fluctuation variance grows as |y|³. The all-height monotonicity and explicit coefficients explain the far-field amplification and supply a complete conditional-age moment hierarchy; these are structurally motivated by the shear and resetting interplay, not an arbitrary parameter slice. Main scientific limitations are simultaneous global resetting and ideal stationary observations.
